title: Guitar in my hand - CLARENCE GATEMOUTH BROWN

lines.l: I was standing at the train station
With my guitar in my hand
Then I went to the airport
With my guitar in my hand
I was looking for my baby
Who flew off with another man
Yeah, she said that she was gone
Yeah, she said she was going
What I've been trying to believe
Gave all my money, gave all I could Gave all my lovin' but that didn't do no good
Yes, I'm lost, man, well, yeah Well, I know you can't understand
